about: The least a reader may score before a run fails. One reversed case fails a run whatever is here. correct_share is the least share of all cases read correctly. unasked_ceiling is the most cases that may hold an edit nobody asked for. plain_correct_share is the least share of the cases marked plain that are read correctly. null means no limit yet. groups may hold a floor for one group by its file name. A model is held to the floor of the provider that runs it, and each provider is measured apart. See evals/README.md.
